meta.notes_for_engineers: This file holds content shared across ALL products. Do not paraphrase, summarize, rewrite, or 'improve' any value. A product's own content file may define the same sequences.<key> or reference.<key> to override this; absent that, every product falls back to the copy here.

ten_steps.intro: The 10-step sales process — the full arc of every in-home visit. The deck covers steps 4–6; everything around it is you.

steps.title: Recap at Table & Confirm Understanding of the Offer
steps.detail: Awnings/screens etc. vs. their outdoor space and logistics — see the Pre-Demo Recap reference.

steps.title: Company Story through Installation & Manufacturer Info
Product Options & Product Demo — Problem / Feature / Benefit
First Visit Discount through Laying Off Price
steps.detail: Rebuild value, pricing & financing / payment options — see the Pricing & Close reference.

steps.title: Ask For the Business / Next Steps
Uncover, Manage & Overcome Objections
steps.detail: See FAQs & Objections for the response scripts.

steps.title: Ask for Referrals · Close / Reset Agenda (If no sale)

do_not: Don't read slides — know the slides
Don't skip tying back to their goals
do: Always relate back to THEIR situation
Build emotion → then logic → then close

four_sales.intro: Per the ATH / Profectus framework — the customer needs to be sold on all four before they commit:
items: Do the project — they believe the problem is worth solving
Do it right — they believe the quality justifies the investment
Do it with ATH — they trust you and the company
Do it now — they have a reason to move forward today
four_sales.footer: If you lose the sale, trace it back to which of these four was not fully closed. That is your gap.
